content.title: Is Costco open on Easter 2026?
content.text: BusinessCostco will be closed on Easter, which falls on Sunday, April 5, 2026.Patti Sapone | NJ Advance Media Easter arrives this Sunday, April 5, and that means it’s the last final days to prepare for the holiday festivities. While it’s not a federal holiday, some stores may decide to close so that staff can celebrate at home with their families. But if you need to do some last-minute shopping, it may not be clear if popular stores, like Costco, will be open on the holiday.Here’s everything you need to know about Costco’s hours this Sunday.Is Costco open on Easter 2026?No, Costco warehouses and gas stations will not be open on Easter Sunday this year. However, stores will be open on April 3 (Good Friday) and April 4, so there’s still some time to pick last-minute odds and ends for holiday festivities. Costco warehouses are open on April 3 and 4, from 9 a.m. to 8:30 p.m. for Executive Members and from 10 a.m to 8:30 p.m. for Gold Star and Business Members. The chain is known for closing on Easter and multiple holidays, including: If you’re planning to visit Costco before Easter, you can find your local warehouse here. What Easter specials are available at Costco?Yes, Costco is offering one deal specifically for the Easter holiday. Costco members who shop at their local warehouse can buy a Kirkland Signature Ham Dinner for $5 per pound from April 1-4. The meal kit comes with the main course and two sides for a large feast.The entire Easter bundle deal comes with: Kirkland Signature Spiral Sliced Hammashed potatoes green beansThe Kirkland Signature Ham Dinner deal is only available at Costco warehouses. You can see if your local warehouse has it here. Like Costco, Lowe’s will be closed on Easter, but you can still stop by Walmart and Dunkin’ because they will be open for the day.Is Walmart open on Easter?
